name: Tim LeMaster

bio.statement: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, LeMaster said they retired to Portland from the Marine Corps in 2013.
bio.excerpt: I retired here in Portland from the Marine Corps in 2013.

positions.statement: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, LeMaster said they would support public safety and police.

positions.statement: In the same 2022 survey, LeMaster said Measure 110 either needs to be repealed or Oregon needs to pursue full decriminalization of illicit drugs.

verification.note: Survey answer (2022, Candidate Connection, HD 43) offers either repeal or pursuing full decriminalization; excerpt extended and statement corrected.
